mapper.insert: insert into a2a_cancellations(tenant_id,cancellation_id,a2a_request_id,child_task_id,assignment_id,execution_attempt_id,attempt_no,dispatch_request_id,agent_id,agent_session_id,owner_gateway_node_id,revoked_fencing_token_hash,active_fencing_token_hash,cancellation_fingerprint,idempotency_key,status,outcome,processing_status,reconciliation_classification,reason,requested_by_type,requested_by_id,delivery_status,last_error,retry_count,reconciliation_count,requested_at,result_cutoff_at,delivery_at,acknowledged_at,deadline_at,next_reconcile_at,last_reconciled_at,completed_at,updated_at,version) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.cancellationId},#{value.requestId},#{value.childTaskId},#{value.assignmentId},#{value.executionAttemptId},#{value.attemptNo},#{value.dispatchRequestId},#{value.agentId},#{value.agentSessionId},#{value.ownerGatewayNodeId},#{value.revokedFencingTokenHash},#{value.activeFencingTokenHash},#{value.cancellationFingerprint},#{value.idempotencyKey},#{value.status},#{value.outcome},#{value.processingStatus},#{value.reconciliationClassification},#{value.reason},#{value.requestedByType},#{value.requestedById},#{value.deliveryStatus},#{value.lastError},#{value.retryCount},#{value.reconciliationCount},#{value.requestedAt},#{value.resultCutoffAt},#{value.deliveryAt},#{value.acknowledgedAt},#{value.deadlineAt},#{value.nextReconcileAt},#{value.lastReconciledAt},#{value.completedAt},#{value.updatedAt},#{value.version}) on conflict(tenant_id,cancellation_id) do update set status=excluded.status,outcome=excluded.outcome,processing_status=excluded.processing_status,reconciliation_classification=excluded.reconciliation_classification,delivery_status=excluded.delivery_status,last_error=excluded.last_error,retry_count=excluded.retry_count,reconciliation_count=excluded.reconciliation_count,delivery_at=excluded.delivery_at,acknowledged_at=excluded.acknowledged_at,deadline_at=excluded.deadline_at,next_reconcile_at=excluded.next_reconcile_at,last_reconciled_at=excluded.last_reconciled_at,completed_at=excluded.completed_at,updated_at=excluded.updated_at,version=excluded.version
mapper.update: update a2a_cancellations set status=#{value.status},outcome=#{value.outcome},processing_status=#{value.processingStatus},reconciliation_classification=#{value.reconciliationClassification},delivery_status=#{value.deliveryStatus},last_error=#{value.lastError},retry_count=#{value.retryCount},reconciliation_count=#{value.reconciliationCount},delivery_at=#{value.deliveryAt},acknowledged_at=#{value.acknowledgedAt},deadline_at=#{value.deadlineAt},next_reconcile_at=#{value.nextReconcileAt},last_reconciled_at=#{value.lastReconciledAt},completed_at=#{value.completedAt},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt},version=#{value.version} where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and cancellation_id=#{value.cancellationId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select * from a2a_cancellations where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and cancellation_id=#{cancellationId}
select * from a2a_cancellations where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId} order by requested_at desc limit 1
select * from a2a_cancellations where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} limit 1

select * from a2a_cancellations where processing_status in('RUNTIME_DELIVERY_PENDING','RUNTIME_ACK_PENDING','FAILED_RETRYABLE') and coalesce(next_reconcile_at,deadline_at) <= #{now} order by coalesce(next_reconcile_at,deadline_at) asc limit #{limit}
select * from a2a_cancellations where tenant_id=#{tenantId} order by requested_at desc limit #{limit}
